$comment: One fixed ledger, and the scores each fold version produces from it. TestFoldGolden looks up the entry whose version equals rapport.FoldVersion and compares. It fails in both directions on purpose: change a delta without bumping the version and the recorded scores stop matching; bump the version without recording an entry and there is nothing to check against. Neither failure can be silenced by editing the other side — adding an entry for a version that does not exist is inert, and editing an existing entry's scores is exactly the thing being guarded against, so do that only together with a version bump and say why in the commit.
ledgerNotes: 05 reverts an AGENT write — it must cost the schedule domain DeltaUndo.
08 reverts a USER write — undoing your own work says nothing about the agent, so nothing moves.
09 is scored against the system domain, which carries no score — it must move nothing.
03 and 10 are rejections: they lower the value but must NOT raise evidence.
11 pushes habit from 0.05 to 0.00 before clamping, so the recorded 0.05 is Floor doing its job rather than arithmetic landing there — remove the clamp and this entry changes.
